IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Ways & Means.

Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing fees for certain health professions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing fees for certain healthprofessions; amending RCW 18.250.080, 18.260.020, 18.74.030, 18.74.070,and 18.74.073; adding a new section to chapter 18.74 RCW; and providingan effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.250.080 and 2007 c 253 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each applicant and license holder must comply withadministrative procedures, administrative requirements, and fees underRCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280 and subsection (2) of this section. Thesecretary shall furnish a license to any person who applies and who hasqualified under the provisions of this chapter. (2) The secretary must collect fees under this chapter as follows: (a) Application fee, one hundred seventyfive dollars; (b) Renewal fee, two hundred dollars; (c) Late renewal penalty fee, two hundred dollars; (d) Expired license reactivation fee, one hundred dollars; (e) Inactive license reactivation fee, forty dollars; (f) Duplicate license copy fee, fifteen dollars; and p. 1 SB 6952 (g) License verification fee, twentyfive dollars.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.260.020 and 2007 c 269 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) No person may practice or represent himself or herself as aregistered dental assistant by use of any title or description withoutbeing registered by the commission as having met the standardsestablished for registration under this chapter unless he or she isexempt under RCW 18.260.110. (b) The secretary must collect the following fees from personsseeking or maintaining the status of a registered dental assistantunder this chapter: (i) Application fee, forty dollars; and (ii) Renewal fee, twenty dollars. (2)(a) No person may practice or represent himself or herself as alicensed expanded function dental auxiliary by use of any title ordescription without being licensed by the commission under this chapterunless he or she is exempt under RCW 18.260.110. (b) The secretary must collect the following fees from personsseeking or maintaining the status of a licensed expanded functiondental auxiliary under this chapter: (i) Application fee, one hundred seventyfive dollars; and (ii) Renewal fee, one hundred sixty dollars.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.74.030 and 2007 c 98 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An applicant for a license as a physical therapist shall havethe following minimum qualifications: (a) Be of good moral character; and (b) Have obtained either (i) a baccalaureate degree in physicaltherapy from an institution of higher learning approved by the board or(ii) a baccalaureate degree from an institution of higher learning anda certificate or advanced degree from a school of physical therapyapproved by the board. (2) An applicant for a license as a physical therapist assistantmust have the following minimum qualifications: (a) Be of good moral character; ((and)) SB 6952 p. 2 (b) Have successfully completed a boardapproved physical therapistassistant program; and (c) Pay a license application fee of one hundred dollars to thesecretary. (3) The applicant shall present proof of qualification to the boardin the manner and on the forms prescribed by the board.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.74.070 and 2007 c 98 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every licensed physical therapist and physical therapistassistant shall apply to the secretary for a renewal of the license andpay ((to the state treasurer)) a fee determined by the secretary asprovided in RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280. (2) Every physical therapist assistant seeking to renew his or herlicense must pay a fee to the secretary as follows: (a) Renewal fee, one hundred twentyfive dollars; (b) Late renewal fee, sixtytwo dollars and fifty cents; and (c) Expired license reissuance fee, seventyfive dollars.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.74.073 and 2007 c 98 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any physical therapist or physical therapist assistant licensedunder this chapter not practicing physical therapy or providingservices may place his or her license in an inactive status. The boardshall prescribe requirements for maintaining an inactive status andconverting from an inactive or active status. The secretary mayestablish fees for alterations in license status. (2) The secretary must collect the following fees from a physicaltherapist assistant seeking to place his or her license on inactivestatus: (a) Inactive status fee, fifty dollars; and (b) Expired inactive status reissuance fee, seventyfive dollars.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.74 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary must collect the following fees from physicaltherapist assistants under this chapter: (1) Issuance of a duplicate license fee, fifteen dollars; and p. 3 SB 6952 (2) Certification of a license fee, twentyfive dollars.
